Adds ComfyUI model provider support to Carapace.

## Distribution

- Package: `@carapace/comfy-provider`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@carapace/comfy-provider`

## Surface

- Providers: `comfy`
- Contracts: `imageGenerationProviders`, `musicGenerationProviders`, `videoGenerationProviders`
